entities.text: Mariamunnisa Begum vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1
 The Honourable Sri Justice E.V. Venugopal
 Criminal Petition No.13626 Of 2024
O R D E R:

This Criminal Petition is filed seeking to quash the proceedings against the petitioner/accused No.2 in C.C.No.9432 of 2020 on the file of the learned XIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate,
Nampally, Hyderabad for the offences under Sections 498A of I.P.C. and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

entities.text:
XIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate,
Nampally, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard Mr.Zulfaquar Alam, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr.Jithender Rao Veeramalla,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent No.1-State.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner/accused No.2 confined his prayer to dispense with the personal appearance of petitioner.

4. Considering the submission of learned counsel for the petitioner, the appearance of the petitioner/accused No.2 is dispensed with in C.C.No.9432 of 2020 on the file of the learned XIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Nampally, Hyderabad when represented by her counsel on record.

entities.text: XIII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Nampally, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The appearance of the petitioner is dispensed with subject to filing an affidavit by the petitioner stating that in her absence, the proceedings conducted by her counsel will not be disputed by her in any manner and shall not dispute his identity also.
However, the petitioner shall appear before the learned Magistrate as and when her presence is required.
In the event of failure of the petitioner to appear when the Court directs, this order dispensing with her appearance shall stand cancelled.
5. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous Petitions, pending if any, shall stand closed.
E.V. VENUGOPAL, J Date: 11.11.2024 ESP Mariamunnisa Begum vs The State Of Telangana on 11 November, 2024
